```{r load-lib, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
# Add any other libraries here
library(dplyr)


```


```{r load-data1}
# load your data 
getwd()

hd_mortalitybyca<- read.csv("data/hd_mortalitybyca.csv")

```

```{r load-data2}
# 1. one year, all ages, both sexes 
hd_total2015 <- hd_mortalitybyca %>% 
  filter(Year == 2015, 
         AgeGroup == "All Ages", 
         Sex == "All",
         Diagnosis == "Coronary Heart Disease") 

# 2. National rate  (Scotland total row) 
scotland_rate <- hd_total2015 %>% 
  filter(Ca == "S92000003") %>% 
  pull(CrudeRate) 

# 3.  above/below national 
hd_councils <- hd_total2015 %>% 
  filter(Diagnosis == "Coronary Heart Disease", Ca != "S92000003") %>%
  mutate(national_rate = scotland_rate,
         difference = CrudeRate - national_rate, 
         status = if_else(CrudeRate > national_rate, "Above national", "Below national")) 

council_area_rate <- hd_councils %>% 
  select(national_rate, difference, status, Ca) 

view(council_area_rate) 

```
